# Frontend

Next.js 15 app built from Stitch exports. Spec: `docs/frontend.md`.

**Rules:** `package.json`, `tsconfig.json` and `messages/*.json` hold `{}` for now, because JSON can't hold comments. Lock files are generated by tools. Tokens stay server-side. AI text renders as plain text. No red for genetic outcomes. Fix contrast first (M5).

**Status:** stubs only. No code until requested.

## Sub-folders

- `app/`
- `components/`
- `design-export/`
- `lib/`
- `messages/`
- `public/`
- `tests/`
